sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Airdrop crate is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 10x12 grid crate that is air-dropped from a Russian Ilyushin Il-76MD-90A airlifter painted fully white with "UN" markings.

sections.heading: Mechanic
sections.text:
A loud plane can be heard and seen flying over the location. It will fire off countermeasure flares in its flight path in even intervals, until it reaches the drop zone, where it fires off multiple flares at once and diverts from its original flight path after dropping a crate. The crate can be dropped at a set number of positions and will slowly fall to the ground via parachute. Once on the ground, the crate will emit red smoke.

Airdrops can also be called in by using a signal pistol with a 26x75mm red flare cartridge or the handheld RSP-30 red flare.

There is a 15-17 minute cooldown period between airdrops which is indicated by a "Wait for arrival! Airspace is congested" notification in the bottom right corner of the screen when trying to call one too early after another. The airdrop will arrive after the cooldown is over.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Airdrops are available on all locations aside from Ground Zero, Factory, The Lab, The Labyrinth, Terminal and Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Types
sections.text: There are 4 different crates that contain loot according to their type. All types also have a chance to come with backpacks.

sections.heading: Common supply
sections.text: Unmarked - Barter items, meds, weapons, ammunition and gear

sections.heading: Medical
sections.text: Marked with a cross symbol - Meds, medical supplies and provisions

sections.heading: Supply
sections.text: Marked with a crate symbol - Barter items

sections.heading: Weapon
sections.text: Marked with a crosshair symbol - Weapons, weapon mods, ammunition and gunpowder
